items.title: Snooky Young and Gerald Wilson interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995
items.q: It’s not like Tyson and those guys.

ctx.x: I think you should explain a battle. How did that work, you know?
A battle really doesn’t mean anything. It’s not like Tyson and those guys.
Did you play a song and then they played a song? Or was it a set?
